name: cavemio-response-versions
title: Response Versions
description: Step between regenerated answers with "2 / 3", and regenerate without losing the old ones.

cavemio.accessibility: Native previous/next buttons are disabled at the ends. The version counter is announced politely. Leaving content is inert and hidden from assistive technology. Regenerate is disabled while busy; reduced motion swaps content immediately and disables the spinner and counter movement.
cavemio.previewNote: A separate assistant-answer wrapper sharing Number Roll with Message Edit. Demo regeneration is simulated locally. The caller owns version history, selected index, and generation requests.

props.name: count
props.description: Required. Total number of response versions.

props.name: index
props.description: Required. Zero-based index of the version shown.

props.name: onIndexChange
props.description: Required. Called with the zero-based index to display.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Optional. Called when a new response is requested.

props.name: regenerating
props.description: Optional. Whether a new response is being generated.
